description: This Java class implements a cache for tenant profiles in the Thingsboard platform, managing tenant profile retrieval, eviction, and listener notifications.

classes.name: DefaultTbTenantProfileCache
classes.description: Implements tenant profile caching with listener support, providing methods to get, put, evict profiles, and manage listeners.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a TenantProfile by its ID, fetching from service if not cached.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a TenantProfile associated with a TenantId, resolving the profile ID if necessary.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds or updates a TenantProfile in the cache and notifies listeners.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes a TenantProfile from cache by its ID and notifies listeners.

methods.name: notifyTenantListeners
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a TenantProfile change.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes tenant from cache and notifies listeners with the current profile.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for a specific tenant profile.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a registered listener for a tenant.
